items.title: Roche commits $750m to double Oregon-based US manufacturing capacity
items.summary: Roche's Oregon fill-finish site will produce both autoinjectors and pre-filled syringes – serving its pipeline and portfolio.

items.title: Eli Lilly’s weekly insulin jab Onswik set for NHS use if approved
items.summary: Lilly’s drug could cut the number of injections each patient needs by 85%.

items.title: WellSpan and Johns Hopkins renew partnership for advanced cancer care access
items.summary: WellSpan Health and Johns Hopkins Medicine have renewed their oncology collaboration to widen access to advanced care throughout central Pennsylvania, US.

items.title: Charles River and MVC to develop enterovirus vaccine
items.summary: Charles River Laboratories International and MVC have entered a collaboration to support the characterisation, along with validation of the virus seed bank for the latter’s next-generation multivalent enterovirus vaccine.

items.title: Regeneron’s Pasatru wins FDA approval in ultra-rare ‘stone man disease’
items.summary: Pasatru demonstrated strong efficacy in a Phase III trial, helping patients reduce lesions and flare-ups.
